source.title: As a Man Thinketh
source.author: James Allen
source.summary: A short philosophical work about mindset, character, and the link between thought and results.
source.corePromise: Show how disciplined thought shapes conduct, reputation, and outcomes.

target.positioning: mental discipline and self-command for creators, founders, and operators

us.evidence: Early twentieth-century publication with a documented public-domain record.

sourceAvailability.location: Public-domain editions available for editorial source review.

titleConcepts: How You Think Is How You Live
subtitleOptions: A Modern Guide to Thought, Character, and Self-Command
Mental Discipline for Founders, Creators, and Operators
Self-Command for the Age of Noise, Drift, and Ambition
adaptation.modernWorld: Founder psychology, personal operating systems, and everyday decision hygiene
toneRules: Keep the prose sharper and more concrete than the original.
Translate moral abstractions into habit and behavior language.
prohibitedChanges: Do not reduce the book to generic positivity.
Do not make claims that thoughts alone create outcomes.
Do not imply endorsement by the original author.
coreLessons: Thought patterns shape conduct and reputation over time.
Circumstances often reveal repeated thought and habit rather than random fate.
The body and the nervous system are influenced by mental hygiene.
Purpose organizes thought and protects effort from drift.
Achievement depends on disciplined thought translated into action.
Vision enlarges character when it is paired with work.
Serenity is a practical advantage, not a decorative virtue.

chapterPlan.title: Thought and Character
chapterPlan.focus: Show that repeated thinking patterns harden into behavior, reputation, and self-command.
chapterPlan.modernFrame: The hidden operating system behind a builder's decisions

chapterPlan.title: Thought and Circumstances
chapterPlan.focus: Argue that external conditions are often shaped by repeated internal habits, standards, and choices.
chapterPlan.modernFrame: How drift, avoidance, and standards alter a modern career or company

chapterPlan.title: Thought and Health
chapterPlan.focus: Connect mental disorder or discipline to energy, posture, resilience, and basic physical maintenance.
chapterPlan.modernFrame: Nervous system health for founders, creators, and knowledge workers

chapterPlan.title: Thought and Purpose
chapterPlan.focus: Make purpose the organizing principle that keeps effort from scattering.
chapterPlan.modernFrame: Focus in a distracted digital economy

chapterPlan.title: The Thought-Factor in Achievement
chapterPlan.focus: Explain how disciplined thought becomes execution, persistence, and eventual results.
chapterPlan.modernFrame: Execution and consistency in modern work

chapterPlan.title: Visions and Ideals
chapterPlan.focus: Show how imagination and ideals elevate work when tied to craft and sacrifice.

chapterPlan.title: Serenity
chapterPlan.focus: Present calm as a form of maturity and leverage under pressure.
